features.quote: I've written this so the battery measures failure *modes and recovery*, not just failure *frequency*.
features.justification_quote: a battery optimized purely to *maximize induction rate* tends to drift into measuring "how hard did we push" rather than "how does the agent fail."
If your judge scores all stopping as failure, you'll harden the model toward never giving up — which is worse.

features.quote: Watch for judge-subject collusion drift if you ever fine-tune against this battery
features.justification_quote: Goodhart — the model learns to look stable to the judge

features.quote: Battery outputs that map "reliable destabilization triggers" are dual-use; treat the trigger catalog as internal-sensitive
